title: POST /v0.1/signin/{provider} request
description: Start signing in with one of the Obysphere server's providers, for the owner key the sign-in will be bound to (spec/sphere-api.md section 3.1).

return_to.description: Where the browser goes back with the sign-in's code: an http URL on this machine (127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1]), or a URL in a scheme the server knows (Oby's, a listed client's, or one its operator names); characters from ! to ~, with no ? or #. Left out: obi-sphere://signin.
